To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
DMG MOSFET is a promising candidate to replace conventional MOSFETs for nanoscale CMOS technologies.
The DMG SON-MOSFET technology is superior to the DMG SOI-MOSFET in terms of SCEs, threshold voltage and performance.
the DMG MOSFETs have better SCEs control and improved performance compared to the single material gate (SMG) SOI MOSFETs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel dual-material gate (DMG), fully-depleted (FD), silicon-on-insulator (SOI) MOSFET with an ultra-thin body (UTB).
the design of novel dual-material gate (DMG), fully depleted silicon-on-insulator (FD-SOI) MOSFETs with high-k dielectrics.
the design and fabrication of a dual-gate MOSFET (DGMOSFET) for low-power and low-voltage digital applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the dual-material gate (DMG)-SOI MOSFET is an attractive device structure for the future nanoscale CMOS technology.
the DMG MOSFETs have more potential against SCEs and hence are more scalable than conventional SOI MOSFETs.

the DMG SON MOS technology offers more potential for further device scaling and improved immunity against short channel effects (DIBL, Vt Roll-off and Subthreshold slope) and is thus found to be a better option than the other two structures.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the DMG SON MOS transistor technology offers further device scalability with better performance.
the DMG SON MOS transistor is more suitable for future nanoscale CMOS applications as compared to the conventional SOI transistor.
the dual material gate SON MOSFET offers better performance in comparison to the SOI MOSFET.
The main takeaway from our work is that
DMG SON MOS structure can be used as a viable alternative to the conventional SOI MOSFET for further device scaling.
a dual-material gate (DMG)-silicon-on-insulator (SOI) MOSFET is more robust against short-channel effects (SCE) than the conventional gate (CG)-SOI MOSFET.
the DMG MOSFET is a promising candidate for future nanoelectronics applications.
